decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL01, PL02, PL03, Design and Access Statement, Householder Flood Risk Assessment received on the 18.05.2015   ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, the proposed extension building shall not be used as consulting rooms for the existing surgery.  This extension shall only be used as ancillary office use for the premises.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and a single storey outbuilding connected by a glazed walkway at the rear garden of the surgery
